tactics: induction t <;> constructor <;> first | assumption | exact F _ _ _ (by assumption)
induction t <;> constructor <;> (try assumption) <;> apply F <;> assumption

induction t with
  | slnil => constructor
  | cons a h ih => exact List.Sublist.below.cons a h ih (F _ _ h ih)
  | cons₂ a h ih => exact List.Sublist.below.cons₂ a h ih (F _ _ h ih)
